name: Maciej Brzeski
intro: Frontend engineer with ~10 years building business web applications in Angular, React and TypeScript. I also make small browser games.
summary: Frontend engineer with ~10 years building business web applications, specialising in TypeScript single-page apps with Angular and, over the last ~2 years, React.

Grew from Junior to Lead over nine years at EPAM Systems, leading engineering teams and delivering products used by over a million people. Works across the stack with Python when a feature needs it, and uses AI coding tools in everyday development.
In my own time I build small browser games, LLM-agent tooling and edge-AI gadgets.

highlights.label: users of one app I delivered

points: Delivered enterprise business applications for international clients, primarily Angular / TypeScript single-page apps, including one serving 1M+ users.
Built with Angular 17–18, using Standalone Components, RxJS and NgRx, on Nx monorepos with Angular Material and SCSS.
Built production features in React and TypeScript, managing client-side state with Redux and Zustand.
Improved front-end performance, cutting time-to-first-paint from several seconds to near-instant.
Drove code quality across large codebases, reducing linter and compiler errors from hundreds to a handful.
Led engineering teams, owning technical direction, solution design, code review and mentoring.
Over the last ~2 years extended into full-stack delivery across Angular / React front-ends and Python back-ends.
Built responsive websites, CMS solutions and interactive front-ends with JavaScript, AngularJS, Node.js, PHP and WordPress.
Manager, DTA (company management, recruitment, partner relations).
Lab assistant, Jagiellonian University crystallography lab and HeidelbergCement.

games.title: Duck Gallery
games.blurb: Carnival shooting-gallery roguelite. Six slots on the counter, weapons and modules buff their neighbours, and some pairs combine (wet + burning = steam). Hit the ticket quota every round or get thrown out of the fair. 15 rounds to win.
games.controls: Move the sight with the mouse, or drag on touch; your guns fire on their own. P or Esc pauses, M mutes. Spend tokens at the prize stand between rounds.
